[LEXP.7.17.1] Geometric / spherical / vector-length / cosine functions
accept numeric operands (`Int` or `Float`); `Int` promotes to
`Float`. Non-matching operand types are compile errors; a wrong-typed `Json` leaf raises a
`TypeError` ([LEXP.7.12.1]); an unresolved path reads as `null` ([LNUL.8.4]).
